name: Terrify (Recharge 4–6)
description: The creature targets one creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 33 (6d10) psychic damage and is frightened of the creature until the end of the creature’s next turn, and the creature regains 5 hit points. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn’t frightened, and the creature doesn’t heal.
